newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly flat across the board on Wednesday, dealers said, following a recovery early losses by the close on Tuesday.

The spot July contract ended down 0.02 cent at 11.34 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.40 to 11.26 cents. Most-active October finished 0.02 cent lower at 11.26 cents, while the outer months went out 0.04 to 0.02 higher.
The July/October spread settled at 0.07 cent compared with 0.08 cent on Monday.
Prices are seen easing back towards 11.00 cents basis July in the near term, as the speculators liquidate long positions ahead of the July expiry on June 30, traders said.

LIFFE white sugar futures were narrowly mixed on Wednesday as the market awaited a sign from New York. At 0848 EDT/1248 GMT, spot August stood $0.40 lower at $323.60, while the back months were trading $0.10 to $0.50 lower.
